node.statement: Matrix-unit corner normalization: after a universal shrink of e, every R_a=v(E_aa) is a one-dimensional delta-prime-projection in A (with delta-prime=O(e)), and every pair R_a,R_b is equivalent, i.e. dim S_{R_a,R_b}=1. All constants and the threshold are independent of r.
